Which web push tool do coffee shops use? Our notes

We looked at how other small shops send browser notifications. Many guides mention OneSignal, Pushwoosh and Webpushr. A typical install guide asks you to add a line like <script src="https://cdn.onesignal.com/sdks/web/v16/OneSignalSDK.page.js"> to your page. You can read more on their website. We are happy with our current setup and are not changing anything.
